tool_description: Save one visible user and assistant conversation pair as either Episodic Memory or an explicit Collection Memory episode. The default memory_type is episodic.

For Episodic Memory, generate Episode Title, Episode Description, and a Recall Key when the user did not supply one. For Collection Memory, target exactly one Collection ID or exact Collection Name, generate the local Episode Title and Description, and provide the cumulative Collection ActiveBrief after incorporating the new episode.

Pass the complete selected visible user message as input_text and the complete corresponding visible assistant answer as output_text without summarizing, rewriting, or substituting hidden reasoning or internal tool traffic.

A Collection append happens only when the user explicitly asks to add or save content to a Collection. GHOST assigns its permanent episode number and can generate a human-readable Recall Key when recall_key is omitted.
Never use M1 through M100 because those names are reserved for Clipboard Memory. Treat the Recall Key returned in the successful receipt as the actual stored key.
server_instruction: For an ordinary Episodic save, call ghost_memory_tag with memory_type episodic, the complete selected visible user and assistant pair, a generated Episode Title and Episode Description, and the exact user-provided or client-generated Recall Key.

When the user explicitly asks to append to Collection Memory, call the same ghost_memory_tag tool with memory_type collection, exactly one exact Collection ID or exact Collection Name, the complete selected visible pair, Episode Title, local Episode Description, and the updated cumulative Collection ActiveBrief. Omit recall_key when the user did not provide one so GHOST can generate it.

Do not append normal conversation turns merely because a Collection exists. After the call, claim success only when saved is true and workflow_state is complete, and report the actual Recall Key, Record ID, and Collection episode number when present.

field_descriptions.memory_type: Use episodic for ordinary intelligent-retrieval memory, or collection for an explicit append to Collection Memory.
field_descriptions.recall_key: For Episodic Memory, the exact user-provided or client-generated Recall Key. For Collection Memory it is optional; when omitted, GHOST generates a human-readable unique key. M1 through M100 are reserved.
field_descriptions.collection_id: The exact stable Collection ID. Supply exactly one Collection ID or Collection Name for a Collection append.
field_descriptions.collection_name: The exact Collection Name. Use it only when it resolves safely and supply no Collection ID in the same call.
field_descriptions.episode_title: A short human-readable title for the selected visible episode, preferably three to ten words.
field_descriptions.episode_description: A compact description of this episode's local contribution. For Episodic Memory it also supports later semantic retrieval.
field_descriptions.input_text: The complete selected visible user message, copied without summarization or rewriting.
field_descriptions.output_text: The complete corresponding visible assistant answer, copied without summarization or rewriting.
field_descriptions.active_retrieval_brief: For Collection Memory, the current cumulative Collection ActiveBrief after incorporating this episode. Omit it for Episodic Memory.
